sections.heading: Before or After Your Delivery Order

blocks.html: Sitting along the Passaic River just minutes from Manhattan by train, Harrison, NJ, packs a remarkable amount of energy and variety into 1.3 square miles. From world-class sports and dining to riverside green spaces and authentic neighborhood flavor, there's always something worth stepping out for. Place your order for cannabis delivery in Harrison that locals count on, and make the most of everything this Hudson County gem has going for it.

blocks.title: Sports Illustrated Stadium
blocks.html: Home to the New York Red Bulls and Gotham FC, Sports Illustrated Stadium is a 20,000-seat soccer-specific venue right in the heart of Harrison that also hosts concerts, international matches, and major events throughout the year. With one of the most electric atmospheres in the New York metro area and a BULLevard fan experience outside the gates, it's a destination that draws crowds from across the region.

blocks.title: Passaic River Greenway
blocks.html: A Hudson County initiative adopted in 2023, the Passaic River Greenway is a publicly accessible trail running along the Passaic River waterfront through Harrison and neighboring communities. Existing sections offer scenic riverside walking paths with views of the water and the Newark skyline, while the broader plan envisions a continuous greenway connecting landmarks, parks, and neighborhoods along the full length of the river.

blocks.title: West Hudson Park
blocks.html: Straddling the Harrison-Kearny border, West Hudson Park is a Hudson County green space with an impressive range of amenities. Baseball and softball fields, soccer fields, basketball courts, four lighted tennis courts, a stocked lake, a water park, tree-lined walking paths, and a section of the East Coast Greenway trail make it one of the most well-rounded parks in the area.

blocks.title: Leña y Carbón
blocks.html: A vibrant Peruvian restaurant on Bergen Street, Leña y Carbón brings bold Latin flavors and a lively atmosphere to Harrison's dining scene. Known for its Pollo al Carbón, fresh ceviches, hearty saltados, and house-made maracuyá sangria, it delivers a dining experience as memorable for its energy and live entertainment as for the food itself.

blocks.title: La Fiamma
blocks.html: A Harrison Avenue staple, La Fiamma is an Italian restaurant offering a generous menu spanning lunch, dinner, happy hour, prix fixe, and early-bird options, alongside a well-curated wine list and full banquet and catering capabilities. It's the kind of neighborhood Italian spot that earns its loyal following one well-executed dish at a time.

blocks.title: Antojos Colombianos
blocks.html: A family-owned Harrison institution since 2003, Antojos Colombianos on Harrison Ave is a Colombian restaurant and bakery with deep roots in the community. The Bandeja Paisa, empanadas, arepas de choclo, Pan de Queso, and natural fruit smoothies in flavors like mango, passion fruit, and blackberry have made it a beloved fixture for residents and visitors alike.

items.q: How old do you have to be for cannabis delivery in Harrison?
items.a_html: New Jersey's adult-use cannabis law sets the minimum age at 21. We’ll verify your age when you create your Lady L account, and your driver will confirm your ID again at the door before the handoff is completed. No exceptions apply.

items.q: What ID is accepted for a Lady L delivery order?
items.a_html: Any valid, government-issued photo ID qualifies. That includes driver's licenses, state-issued IDs, and passports, and out-of-state IDs are welcome. Your ID must be uploaded to your Lady L account before your first order, and the physical ID must be present when your driver arrives.

items.q: Do I need a medical cannabis card for delivery in Harrison?
items.a_html: No medical card is required. Lady L is an adult-use dispensary open to any customer 21 or older. A confirmed Lady L account and a valid ID are all you need to get started.

items.q: What’s the purchase limit for a cannabis delivery in Harrison?
items.a_html:
New Jersey law allows us to sell up to the equivalent of 28.35 grams, or one ounce, of usable cannabis per transaction. That total can include any combination of the following:

  • Dried Flower/Bud: 28.35 grams (1 ounce).
  • Concentrates/Resin/Oils: 4 grams (solid or liquid/vaporized oil).
  • Ingestible Items (Gummies/Edibles): 1,000 mg of THC (roughly ten 100mg packages).
  • Maximum Possession Limit: Up to 6 ounces of cannabis and cannabis products.
  • Mixing Products: You can mix and match, for example, by purchasing 1/2 ounce of flower and 2 grams of concentrates.
  • Daily Limits: The 1-ounce limit is generally considered a daily limit across all dispensaries.

items.q: What are the taxes on cannabis delivery orders?
items.a_html: New Jersey adult-use cannabis purchases include a 6.625% state sales tax, a 2% municipal transfer or user tax, where applicable, and a $2.50-per-ounce Social Equity Excise Fee (SEEF). These taxes apply equally to delivery orders, and every applicable charge is itemized at checkout before you confirm.

items.a_html: Typical delivery time runs approximately one hour, though traffic, order volume, and distance can all be factors. If your order is running late, reach out to our team directly. We monitor every order and address delays as quickly as possible.
